items.title: Bloom Energy Stock Jumps On 'Meaningful' Data-Center Catalyst

items.title: Former Waymo CFO jumps to self-driving startup Wayve
items.summary: Elisa de Martel, who left her position as chief financial officer at Alphabet's autonomous vehicle company Waymo in January, will be based out of Silicon Valley.

items.title: GOOGL, DeepMind Launch Institute To Examine Artificial General Intelligence, Says Report — Why Its Leaders Say AI Safety Can’t Be Country-Specific
items.summary: The new forum will bring together Google, DeepMind, and external researchers to examine AGI’s potential impact on economics, society, and human progress, Axios reported.

items.title: Apple Gives Siri AI Makeover With iOS 27, Caps Usage; Gene Munster Flags 'Way to Long, 5-15 Seconds' Response Time
items.summary: Before its latest iPhone model hits shelves next week, Apple Inc. rolled out iOS 27 on Monday, which features a reimagined Siri AI personal assistant. The Siri AI can be accessed via a new Siri app that saves previous queries....

items.title: Google Delays Thompson Center Opening To 2028, Releases New Renderings
items.summary: The tech giant had targeted early 2027 to move into the building but now plans to "officially open our doors to Googlers, tenants and the public in 2028."

items.title: What Happens To Apple Stock If Its Margin Keeps Slipping?
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) reported a record June quarter, with revenue up 16%. The stock has returned 42% over the past year against 17% for the S&P 500. That is a price built on everything going right, and by Apple's own guide the margin behind it is already giving way.

items.title: DTE Is Sitting on an AI-Era Power Opportunity
items.summary: Michigan's largest utility just signed hyperscale data center deals that could rewrite its earnings story, but a recent sell-off near 52-week lows is raising questions about whether the opportunity is real or already priced in.
